name: stall-depth
description: Decode stalls and short-request waits while a cold 131K prompt prefills, at four depths of the sixteen slots, about 16 minutes a build on the ring: 3, 7 and 11 decoding streams with 500-token probes sent 2-14 s into the prefill, and 15, which with the long prompt fills every slot (no probes: they would queue for a slot). Four repeats each. Built for experiments/2026-10-28-candidate-10-levers: a site triangle measured prefill yield doubling decode stalls with free slots (#650).
